registers.label: Spare
lines: How lovely is your dwelling place, O Lord of hosts.
Our souls long for the courts of the living God.
This teaching is hard; many turned and walked away.
But Lord, to whom shall we go?
Will God really dwell on the earth with us?
Heaven cannot hold you, yet you meet us here.
You have the words of eternal life; come, let us worship.
We have come, and we will stay. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: How lovely is your dwelling place; even the sparrow finds a home and the swallow a nest near your altar, O Lord of hosts.
Give us this bread always.
Solomon stood in the finished temple and wondered aloud: will God truly dwell on earth, when heaven itself cannot contain you?
Give us this bread always.
The teaching was hard, and many who had followed turned back and walked with him no more; he asked the twelve, will you also go?
Give us this bread always.
And Peter answered for all of us: Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life; so here we are, and here we stay.
Give us this bread always. You have the words of eternal life.
